attchmntText: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results at a meeting held on November 13, 2026, following review by the Audit Committee. The company published newspaper advertisements in Business Standard and Aaj-Hindi on November 14, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The financial results are available on the company website at www.jaykayenterprises.com and on the BSE and NSE websites. The announcement also includes extracts of financial results from other entities including KBS India Limited, Naga Dhunseri Group Limited, Gee Limited, Peninsula Land Limited, John Cockerill India Limited, Aditya Birla Grasim Industries Limited, and UltraTech Cement Limited for the same period.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report in respect of Rights Issue (2026) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue undertaken in 2026. The report was issued by Acuité Ratings and Research Limited. The total issue size was INR 154.29 crore. The monitoring agency observed no deviation from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. No material deviations in expenditure were noted. There was no change in the means of finance. No major deviations were observed compared to earlier reports, as this is the first such report. All necessary government and statutory approvals were obtained. No arrangements for technical assistance were required. No favorable or unfavorable events affecting the viability of the objects were observed. No other material information affecting investor decision-making was evident. The issuer has not utilized any funds towards the objects during the reporting period. Unutilized proceeds were maintained in escrow and current accounts.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report in respect of Rights Issue (2024) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Rights Issue undertaken in 2024. The report was issued by Acuité Ratings and Research Limited. The total issue size was INR 146.14 crore. As of the reporting date, INR 137.42 crore has been utilized, leaving an unutilized balance of INR 8.72 crore. The Monitoring Agency observed no material deviations from the objects of the issue. However, progress on several objects is delayed. Specifically, the purchase of plant and machinery for JK Defence and JK Digital is delayed. The issuer has not utilized any amount for these objects during the reporting period. Additionally, the construction of buildings for JK Defence and interior works for JK Digital are delayed. General Corporate Expenses were fully utilized, though the completion date was delayed by 170 days. Funds of INR 1.87 crore were used for the acquisition of Patange Industries Private Limited in June 2026. Unutilized proceeds are held in current accounts and fixed deposits with SBI.

attchmntText: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited filed an investor release regarding consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 116.16 crore, showing 69 percent year-on-year growth. Profit after tax was 8.66 crore. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income was 192.95 crore, a 32 percent increase. Profit after tax was 13.18 crore. The company received AS9100D Accreditation for its Precision Manufacturing Division. Subsidiary Allen Reinforced Plastics Ltd secured defence orders worth 60.01 crore from BrahMos Aerospace. The Devanahalli project is on track for completion by the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026-27 or the first quarter of fiscal year 2027-28. Regulatory approvals for medical implants were received from CDSCO. The company provided for delayed receivables due to business disruptions in the Middle East.

attchmntText: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has submitted to the Exchange the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board reported a net profit of 49.42 lakh for the quarter and 50.68 lakh for the half year. The company issued 2,05,71,642 rights equity shares at a premium of Rs.74 per share on September 23, 2026. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved granting 13,000 employee stock options under the JKE Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025. The statutory auditors noted that the subsidiary Neumesh Labs Private Limited has a negative net worth of Rs. 3534.11 lakh and has paused commercial operations. No provision for credit impairment was recognized for the subsidiary. The financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and the statutory auditors.
